document.abstract: Two major points affecting film life in 16-mm and 8-mm projectors are the shape of the film path entering and leaving the sprocket and the shape of the sprocket tooth. The following recommendations, approved by the Society, have been developed to assist the design engineer in specifying these, as well as other dimensions for particular applications.
